items.title: 32.1 Therapeutic index aur therapeutic window (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 32.1, printed page 230 (PDF 233).

blocks.text: Pharmacology woh science hai jo batati hai ke dawa jism mein kya karti hai aur kin safety margins (mehfooz hadon) ke andar kaam karti hai. Har dawa poison (zehr) ban sakti hai; farq sirf dose (dawa ki miqdar) ka hai. Therapeutic index aur therapeutic window do central (sab se ahem) concepts hain jin se samajh aata hai ke koi dawa kitni safe (mehfooz) aur kitni effective (asar karne wali) hai. In ki madad se doctor tay karte hain ke mareez ko dawa ki kitni miqdar deni hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Paani bhi zyada pi liya jaye to nuqsan deta hai, aur zehr ki bohat thori miqdar kuch nahi karti. Isi tarah dawa ka faida ya nuqsan us ki miqdar (dose) par hai; isi liye aage therapeutic window aur therapeutic index parhenge.

blocks.prompt: Kyun kaha jata hai ke har dawa zehr ban sakti hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke asar dose par hai: kisi bhi dawa ki had se zyada miqdar nuqsan deti hai.

items: Pharmacology: dawa kya karti hai aur kin safety margins mein kaam karti hai.
Dawa aur zehr ka farq dose ka hai.
Therapeutic index aur therapeutic window se sahi dose tay hoti hai.
